result.boundary: Rigid instances form one batch per view; fixed and micro raster share one preparation. Exact frozen-clock comparisons across batch sizes, every batching switch, both occlusion modes and both visibility formats pass. The first-move pipeline stall is gone. Average frame rate gained about one percent; rows of different reports are not comparable because the machine state differed between batches. CPU profiles were taken on a busy machine and are used for on/off differences only. Full enabled performance acceptance stays open.
